SELECT count(DISTINCT t1.id_student) FROM studentAssessment AS t1 JOIN assessments AS t2 ON t1.id_assessment = t2.id_assessment WHERE t2.code_module = 'BBB' AND t2.code_presentation = '2013J' AND t2.assessment_type = 'TMA' GROUP BY t1.id_student HAVING count(DISTINCT t2.id_assessment) = (SELECT count(*) FROM assessments WHERE code_module = 'BBB' AND code_presentation = '2013J' AND assessment_type = 'TMA')
